Bill.BriefDescription: Studying excise tax relief for aerospace product development businesses.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to excise tax relief for aerospace productdevelopment businesses; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The joint legislative audit and reviewcommittee shall study the effect of enacting tax preferences foraerospace product development businesses. The committee shallsummarize its findings in the form of a report. The report shallestimate the effect of enacting tax preferences for aerospace productbusinesses on job retention, job growth, company growth,diversification of the state's economy, cluster dynamics, and otherfactors the committee may select. The report is due to the housefinance and senate ways and means committees by December 1, 2007. (2) For the purposes of this section, aerospace product developmentbusinesses are businesses not directly claiming currently authorizedaerospace tax incentives that are engaged in the development, design,engineering, or manufacturing of: (a) Tooling that is used: (i) In the manufacturing of commercialairplanes; or (ii) by manufacturers of component parts for commercialairplanes; p. 1 SHB 1554 (b) Maintenance, repair, or overhaul support equipment that is usedby airline customers in the aftermarket support of commercialairplanes; (c) Ground support equipment, including test equipment, that isused by airline customers in support of commercial airplanes; or (d) General aviation aircraft and components of such aircraft.
